messages:
Vik (Marketplace): Quick sync - partner wants a turnkey "redwood-cloudpartner-x" Terraform + packaging bundle for marketplace listing. Need owners for iac, CI, tests, and listing metadata.

Noor (DevEx): I can take the TF modules and examples. Prefer we publish a `v0.1.0` starter tag and iterate. Where should the examples live? examples/hello-llm?

Rina (Cloud Eng): examples/hello-llm sounds good. Also add a `deploy/` folder with k8s helm chart and a docker-compose for single-host.

Tomas (Security): Security checklist: VPC design, least-priv IAM policies, KMS envelope example, and audit log sample. I'll provide a checklist doc and a short snippet for KMS policy.

Noor (DevEx): Proposed module layout: modules/core-network, modules/inference-pool, modules/kv-cache, examples/hello-llm, tests/acceptance. Semver + CHANGELOG.md.

Vik (Marketplace): Marketplace needs: short description, support contact, pricing SKU, minimal deploy script, and a screenshot of the console flow. I'll own listing metadata and screenshots.

Rina (Cloud Eng): CI requirements: matrix across arch/GPUs + infra smoke tests. Example matrix for GitHub Actions:
```yaml
strategy:
  matrix:
    os: [ubuntu-latest]
    arch: [x86_64, arm64]
    gpu: [none, nvidia]
```
Tests should run a tiny inference against the container and verify response within 2s.

CI Bot: E2E runner provisioned - linux/amd64 queued.

Noor (DevEx): Acceptance tests:
- deploy TF modules to transient account
- run a healthcheck hitting /v1/health and a quick generate
- validate metrics exported to prometheus stub
I'll add terraform workspace scripts under tests/.

Tomas (Security): For Private installs include HSM/KMS mapping and a note about air-gapped image transfer (signed tarball + checksum). Also add guidance for SOC/ISO artifacts link.

Rina (Cloud Eng): Packaging: produce a release tarball containing: helm chart (templates/), docker image tags (manifest.txt), terraform modules, and a `marketplace.yml` with metadata. Use tag pattern: `cloudpartner-x-vX.Y.Z+sha`.

Noor (DevEx): I'll prototype the `marketplace.yml` fields: name, description, short_description, support_email, install_script, required_roles. Example: 
```yaml
name: Redwood CloudPartner X Reference Architecture
short_description: Reference deployment for CloudPartner X using Redwood inference
requirements:
  - k8s >=1.24
  - docker 20.10
support_email: marketplace-support@redwood.com
```

Vik (Marketplace): Good. Add a 50-75 word customer-friendly blurb for the listing. I can polish screenshots and legal blurb.

Noor (DevEx): Also adding a small quickstart README with: 1) clone 2) set creds 3) terraform init/apply 4) curl health. Will include sample env var file and a troubleshooting section for the typical AWS errors.

Rina (Cloud Eng): Reminder: do not hardcode AMIs or machine types. Provide recommended instance families and a `node_selector` example for k8s.

Tomas (Security): I'll add an example minimal IAM role policy and a note to rotate encryption keys every 90 days.

Noor (DevEx): Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/partner-iac/pull/999 - includes module skeleton, examples/hello-llm, CI matrix.

Release Bot: Release draft created for tag cloudpartner-x-v0.1.0.

Vik (Marketplace): Timeline check: PR -> internal review 48h -> partner review 72h -> publish. We should aim for listing live in 2 weeks.

Noor (DevEx): Action items recap:
- Noor: TF modules, examples, quickstart, CI matrix.
- Rina: packaging scripts, helm chart, docker-compose.
- Tomas: security checklist + IAM/KMS snippets.
- Vik: marketplace metadata + screenshots + publish flow.

Noor (DevEx): sample TF usage snippet for reviewers:
```hcl
module "cloudpartner_x" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/partner-iac.git//modules/inference-pool"
  region = var.region
  desired_capacity = 2
  instance_type = var.instance_type # override recommended families
}
```

Vik (Marketplace): Tagging @Tomas for security signoff once the checklist is in. Anything else?

Tomas (Security): Please include a short troubleshooting table (common TF errors and remediation). I'll review the PR after CI passes.

CI Bot: integration tests started - params os=[ubuntu-latest], arch=[x86_64,arm64], gpu=[none,nvidia].

Noor (DevEx): Thanks team — will update PR with comments and notify partner when we have an initial tag. :rocket:
